user_story: As a user, I want to interact with buttons on the Buttons page so that I can trigger different actions like clicking, double-clicking, and right-clicking. Acceptance criteria: 1. When I click the button with id 'sp5Bi', the expected action occurs. 2. When I double-click the button with id 'doubleClickBtn', the expected action occurs. 3. When I right-click the button with id 'rightClickBtn', the expected action occurs.
